response.subtitle: TACC Resource Login and Job Submissions
response.webtitle: TACC Resource Login and Job Submissions
response.content: Several TACC resources, including Stampede3, Vista, Lonestar6 and the Analysis Portal are experiencing abnormal behavior when attempting to login or submit jobs to the queues. TACC administrators are working to resolve the issues. Please refer to this announcement for updates.

updates.content: Login and job submission functions have been restored for Stampede3, Vista, Lonestar6 and the Analysis Portal. If you are still experiencing issues with those functionalities, please submit a ticket: https://tacc.utexas.edu/portal/tickets

response.author: David Cooper
response.title: Ranch Data Migration Reminder, EOS Nov 1st, 2026
response.content: As initially announced in September 2025, the Ranch hardware upgrade requires all users to manually curate, then move, all data from the old hardware (old ranch) to the new hardware (new ranch).  See the instructions here https://docs.tacc.utexas.edu/hpc/ranch-migration-2025/TACC Staff will be removing the symbolic links to old Ranch effective November 1st, 2026.Ensure your data has been migrated prior to this date.
